info.event: High Risk Landslide and Mudflow Hazard
info.headline: Red Warning: Slope Failure and Debris Mudflow Hazard along Alaknanda Valley in Chamoli
info.description: Continuous torrential rainfall leading to extreme soil saturation on steep mountain slopes. Imminent threat of major debris flow and highway blockage along Badrinath National Highway in Chamoli district.
info.instruction: Halt all vehicular movement along hill routes. Inhabitants of downstream riverbank settlements and unstable slope zones must relocate to designated emergency shelters immediately.
